name: make-app
description: Make App helps you turn an idea into a working app, with no coding. It plans your app, gives ready-made starting points for common kinds of apps, maps its screens and features, suggests names and a look, makes a clickable prototype, writes your App Store and Google Play listing and checks it against store limits and rules, and gets you ready to launch. When you want it built, answer 5 quick questions and it prepares a personalized link that opens an online app builder with your app brief filled in, as a mobile app for iPhone and Android or a web app. The reply with the build link ends with a one-line sponsor disclosure.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your idea into an app
interface.longDescription:
Make App helps you turn an idea into a working app by chat, with no coding: it plans the app, its screens and its store listing, and when you want it built, it prepares a personalized build link after 5 quick questions, for a mobile app for iPhone and Android or a web app.

What you can do:
- Plan your app: the problem, your users, the features of a first version and what can wait.
- Start fast: ready-made starting points for booking, habit and fitness tracking, marketplace, community, ordering, events, learning, client portal and small business apps.
- Map screens and features: every screen, what it shows and does, and features like sign-up, payments, bookings and notifications, explained without jargon.
- Name it and give it a look: app name ideas with a store subtitle, colors, fonts and icon direction.
- See it first: a clickable HTML prototype of your main screens to preview and share.
- Get into the stores: write your App Store or Google Play listing and check it against store limits and metadata rules, with a prioritized list of fixes.
- Launch: a pre-launch checklist, launch-day steps and the first weeks after.
- Get a build link: answer 5 quick questions and get a personalized link that opens an online app builder with your app brief already filled in.

Who it is for: founders, small business owners, creators, teachers and anyone with an app idea and no coding background.

How the tools work: the listing checker analyzes only the listing text you share in the conversation. It never opens store pages, and the listings and briefs you send are not stored. The build link opens an online app builder with your brief and includes the plugin creator's affiliate code. Make App is an independent plugin by AI Research Plus.

Limitations: Make App writes plans, prototypes, listings and checklists in the conversation. It does not publish apps, create store accounts or submit to the App Store or Google Play for you. Details it cannot know about your app or business are marked for you to confirm or fill in.

The reply with the build link ends with a one-line sponsor disclosure.

positive.prompt: Check my App Store listing. Name: TaskFlow Pro BEST App. Subtitle: Tasks. Keywords: tasks, todo, android, taskflow
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the listing checker with store app_store and the name, subtitle and keywords, reports an overall score of 49, capped until the high-severity issue is fixed, flags "android" in the keyword field, "best" and the ALL CAPS word in the name, the keywords already searchable from the name and the short subtitle, then suggests fixes in severity order.

positive.prompt: Review my Google Play listing. Title: FitPal #1 Workout App. Short description: The best free fitness app!
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the listing checker with store google_play and the title and short description, reports an overall score of 49, capped until the high-severity issues are fixed, flags the "#1" claim in the title and "best" and "free" in the short description as store rule risks, and suggests compliant rewrites within 30 and 80 characters.

positive.prompt: Improve my App Store keywords. Name: Plant Pal. Subtitle: Water reminders for plants. Keywords: plant,pal,water,care
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the listing checker with store app_store, reports that "plant", "pal" and "water" are already searchable from the name and subtitle and that the keyword field uses 20 of 100 bytes, then proposes a new keyword field close to 100 bytes with no repeated words.

positive.prompt: Check my Google Play short description: Track your budget, save money and reach goals faster with smart reminders and charts
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the listing checker with store google_play and the short description, reports that it is 84 characters while Google Play allows 80, with the overall score capped at 49, then suggests rewrites within 80 characters with their counts.

positive.prompt: Check my App Store subtitle: The easiest way to plan meals for your whole family
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the listing checker with store app_store and the subtitle, reports that it is 51 characters while the App Store allows 30, with the overall score capped at 49, then suggests subtitles of 30 characters or fewer with their counts.

publication.release_notes: Make App's skills are now grouped into four: making the app, planning and design, store listing and launch, and reviews. Store listings are now checked right in the chat. The personalized link that opens an online app builder with your brief filled in still comes after 5 quick questions, and the reply with the link ends with a one-line sponsor disclosure.
